public static bool LooksLikeShellCommandLine(string command)
        => command.Contains("&&", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || command.Contains("||", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || command.Contains('|')
            || command.Contains(';')
            || command.Contains('>')
            || command.Contains('<')
            || command.Contains('$')
            || Regex.IsMatch(command, @"(^|\s)cd\s");
